title: Service overview
content: Bennett University's centrally managed transport department operates defined routes that include key pick-up points such as metro stations. The buses are air-conditioned and the university states that transport guidelines are updated in line with government and UGC directives.

title: Eligibility
content: Bennett University states that transportation services are available to day scholars, resident students, faculty and staff.

title: Charges
content: Transport charges are based on the distance travelled to and from the university.

title: Helpline
content: The current Transportation Facility page lists the Transport Helpline as +91 9319993116.

title: Route 1
content: The current page lists Route 1 pickup locations as Chhattarpur Metro, Saket Metro, Green Park Metro Station, South Extension and Lajpat Nagar before Bennett University.

title: Route 5
content: The current page lists Route 5 pickup locations including Shahdara Metro Station, Dilshad Garden Metro Station, Rajbagh Metro Station Ghaziabad, Major Mohit Sharma Metro Station, Mohan Nagar and Sahibabad Mandi before Bennett University.

title: Weekend shuttle
content: Bennett University's transportation overview states that weekend shuttle services are arranged to nearby shopping areas, malls and the closest metro station.

title: Historical policy
content: The 2024 Student Transport Policy is retained as historical source material. Current transport rules, routes and charges should take precedence when a newer official source exists.
